vaultKubeAuthMountPath.description: For testing only (supports a single cluster): Kubernetes auth mount path in Vault. Defaults to the managed cluster name.

vaultKubernetesRole.description: Kubernetes role in Vault for Crossplane to use.

vaultKubernetesRoleExtraPolicies.description: Additional Vault policies assigned to the Kubernetes role, e.g. [admin] until the role policy covers all paths managed by the provider.

vaultProviderServiceAccount.description: Service account of the Crossplane Vault provider allowed to log in with the Kubernetes role.

crossplaneNamespace.description: Namespace where Crossplane is installed and configurations are created.
